title: Only one sham in package.
text:
Only one sham in package.. Just big enough for my double bed. Too small for queen.
Missing a sham. Fortunately I had other white shams but would like the one to match set.
Dust rufflevery plain bit used a different one
Only 3 stars because of missing sham

features: Cotton Comforter Set offers a shabby chic update to your bedroom decor.

Naturally breathable and lightweight cotton fabric paired with a polly fill will bring you year round comfort.
